concepts.name: 余烬·噬角
concepts.detail: Scarlet and crimson with coral edge accents. A brutal BROAD short chisel dagger, asymmetric REVERSE-TANTO profile: thick nearly rectangular lower blade tapering through one sharply slanted plane into an angular forward point. One pronounced V-shaped bite recessed in back edge near blade root, but a clean continuous single cutting edge. Two broad stepped bevel planes emphasize wedge volume, no regular serrations. Solid offset hexagonal ricasso, small squat asymmetric angular crossguard; chunky straight octagonal grip; low flattened cuboid pommel. Dense compact aggressive shape, not a narrow leafblade. A handful of small red lozenge sparks.

concepts.name: 流萤·回牙
concepts.detail: Emerald jade with turquoise and mint highlights. An elegant short HOOKED dagger: single broad faceted C-shaped crescent cutting blade curves distinctly rightward then inward at tip, with ONE slim crescent-shaped aperture running through the blade's thick spine near its root. Continuous wide cutting band and rounded angular outside back. A small rear thumb horn emerges from guard while normal axial straight grip remains clear. A large beveled open triangular ring POMMEL visually echoes blade curve. Substantial green blade, not thin wire. A few tiny curved mint chips around hooked tip. Avoid two parallel full-length blade strips.

concepts.name: 寒汐·穿隙
concepts.detail: Cobalt blue body planes with cyan and turquoise edges. A precise short PIERCED STILETTO dagger: tapered straight triangular spear-point blade, elongated narrow triangular hollow centered within upper 65 percent, TWO substantial solid bevelled cutting rails meet physically in ONE solid sharp tip. Bottom blade root is broad and solid; all blade components structurally continuous. Very small transverse rectangular guard, short octagonal grip with two broad facets, compact trapezoidal pommel. Elegant narrow thrusting silhouette, not a fork or trident; no long sword proportions. A few tiny cyan needle-shaped particle streaks aligned beside tip.

concepts.name: 梦隙·隐棱
concepts.detail: Royal violet and indigo with orchid lilac bright edges, NO red. An inventive asymmetric FOLDED dagger: short broad pointed blade composed of TWO solid angular wedge planes offset in depth, one tall kite-shaped upper blade and one shorter diagonal lower cutting plane joined firmly by a thick slanting spine. A single open zigzag narrow slot between planes emphasizes the offset fold, with a physically connected common root and ONE main point. Profile has an angular S-shaped waist, strikingly asymmetric like folded geometric paper but visibly thick. Small split-level parallelogram guard, conventional straight one-hand grip, compact faceted diamond pommel. No triple fan blades, no floating pieces, no ornaments that block grip. Several tiny lilac triangular chips near blade.
